facts.text: Dear Diary, tonight I'm skipping croquet and staying in. Snacks are ready, and nobody here is named Heather.
facts.why: Veronica never says this. A real J.D. line fits the slushie cue and is short enough to fit.
facts.fix: Our love is God, let's go get a Slushie.
